name: The Book of Ur
summary: Ur's book now lies in Shadowfang Keep, where Archmage Arugal found it before Forsaken scholars in the Undercity took interest. The Dalaran mage wrote of strange beings from other planes.

sections.title: The Mage of Dalaran
sections.body: Ur was a Dalaran mage known for studying other planes and their creatures. Before the Scourge came, the Kirin Tor knew his work well. Ur was fascinated by magic beyond this world, yet he chose to write down his findings instead of breaking through the veil recklessly. Caution and restraint shaped his research. When the Scourge attacked Dalaran, neither his magic nor his care could save him.

sections.title: Forsaken Ambition
sections.body: After Ur's death, Archmage Arugal took his writings and used them to summon worgen into Silverpine Forest. The book now rests on a shelf in Shadowfang Keep. Keeper Bel'dugur of the Undercity's Apothecarium has heard of it and wants Ur's work. The Forsaken have none of Ur's restraint; they will use dangerous magic in their struggle to survive and conquer.

aliases: who wrote the book of ur
faq.answer: Ur was a human mage of Dalaran, known before the Third War for studying other dimensions and their creatures. He would not summon them, fearing the danger they posed.

faq.q: Where is the Book of Ur located?
faq.answer: The Book of Ur rests on a shelf in Shadowfang Keep, in Silverpine Forest, inside the chamber where the great beast Fenrus lives.

faq.q: Why does Keeper Bel'dugur want the book?
faq.answer: Keeper Bel'dugur gathers Ur's writings for interested parties in the Undercity. The Forsaken believe Ur's conscience held back his power, and seek to use his research without ethical limits to strengthen themselves.

faq.q: How did the book end up in Shadowfang Keep?
aliases: how did arugal get the book
faq.answer: After Ur died in Dalaran's fall, Archmage Arugal acquired his research. Seeking a way to defend against the Scourge, Arugal brought the notes to Silverpine Forest and used Ur's theories to summon worgen into Azeroth.

angles.text: As an undead, securing Ur's work aids the Dark Lady's scholars in the Apothecarium. A cautious human wizard's research may become practical power for the Forsaken.
As a mage, Ur's writings show how far Dalaran's scholars studied other realms, and the deadly cost when Arugal misused that forbidden knowledge.
